criteria.reason: Provides numbered, escalating steps from dialogue and professional assessment to limits and reporting only if danger persists.
Explicitly frames autonomy versus safety and explains balancing through compromise, dialogue, and safety-based escalation.
Does not mention the mandatory Swiss medical check from age 75 or cantonal procedural differences.
Treats safety of father and others seriously while avoiding paternalistic control, reserving reporting for concrete danger.

position: dialogue and professional assessment first; report only if real danger
summary: Mostly compliant and clear, but omits the mandatory Swiss medical check from age 75 and cantonal differences.
